research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Talkable is researching a system and method specifically tailored for the inclusion and sharing of short form video within referral marketing. According to the abstract, the system displays a share screen to an advocate who can record or attach a video as part of a referral campaign. This work focuses on enhancing refer a friend program workflows with embedded short form video capture, attachment, and sharing capabilities, advancing referral marketing and advocate driven video content generation.

overview_description.description:
Talkable (formerly Curebit) helps online stores increase revenue through referrals by turning existing customers into marketers.

When customers check out from a Talkable-enabled store, they are presented personalized deals that they can gift to their friends by posting to Facebook or forwarding a link. The deals give both the the original customer and their referred friends a rebate on their purchase at this store.

about_short_description.short_description: Talkable is a technology platform that enables marketers to run customizable Refer A Friend Programs.

product.name: Enterprise Referral Marketing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables businesses to create, manage, and optimize referral marketing campaigns with features like segmentation, fraud prevention, and A/B testing.

product.name: Video Referrals
product.description: A feature that allows customers to create and share video-based referrals, generating authentic user-generated content for marketing use.

product.name: A/B Testing Suite
product.description: A tool to run experiments on referral campaigns by testing different offers, placements, and designs to identify the most effective configurations.

product.name: Data & Reporting Dashboard
product.description: An analytics platform providing detailed insights and reporting on referral program performance and ROI.

product.name: Segmentation Tools
product.description: Functionality to target specific customer groups based on behavioral and purchase data to deliver personalized referral offers and rewards.

product.name: Fraud Prevention System
product.description: An algorithm-driven system designed to detect and prevent fraudulent referral activities, protecting brands from invalid referrals.
